description: Extract a deck from a DocSend or Papermark sharing link. Returns a temporary download URL and a readable `deckextract://deck/...` resource for the PDF/PPTX (or a ZIP for data rooms — a DocSend Space or Papermark data room counts as one extraction like any other link). Pass `analyze: true` (part of DeckExtract for Funds) to also return structured deck data. Decks that email the viewer a verification step return resume tokens with retry instructions: fetch the emailed 6-digit code and retry with `otp` + `otpSessionId` (Papermark), or retry with `url` set to the emailed confirmation link + `sessionId` (DocSend). Typical extraction takes 15-90 seconds; the public API is rate limited to 5 extractions per IP per 30 minutes.

analyze.description: If true, also return structured analysis of the deck (company, team, round, metrics, market, competition). Part of DeckExtract for Funds.

email.description: Email to present to email-gated decks. If omitted, an ephemeral address is generated automatically when the deck requires one.

otp.description: The 6-digit verification code the deck emailed to the viewer (requires_email_otp step). Send together with otpSessionId.

otpSessionId.description: Resume token from a prior requires_email_otp reply. The parked session lives ~5 minutes; a wrong code returns a fresh token.

sessionId.description: Resume token from a prior requires_password or requires_email_confirmation reply. Echo it on the retry so the same viewer session is reused.

url.description: The deck sharing link, e.g. https://docsend.com/view/... or https://papermark.com/view/... — on a requires_email_confirmation retry, pass the confirmation link from the verification email instead.

name: deckextract

analysis.description: Structured deck analysis (present when analyze=true succeeded)

analysisError.description: Set when extraction succeeded but analysis could not be produced

downloadUrl.description: Temporary URL of the extracted deck

expiresAt.description: ISO timestamp when the URL/resource expires

resourceUri.description: MCP resource URI (deckextract://deck/...) to read the bytes via resources/read

title: Extract a DocSend or Papermark deck
